trial_window.sample_rule: include volume times t where insight_onset <= t < insight_onset + 10.0; with TR=1 this is start_idx=ceil(insight_onset), end_idx=ceil(insight_onset+10), Python-exclusive end
trial_window.haiku_viewing_window: matched search_{condition} onset to search onset + 30.0 s
trial_window.drop_trials_if: no matching insight_{condition}; no matching search_{condition}; or insight_onset + 10.0 > search_onset + 30.0; or window extends beyond run length
trial_window.rationale: Align GCA extraction with the insight-locked GLM. Use a focused immediate post-insight neural-estimate window, not the search/onset viewing window; deconvolution makes an additional HRF shift unnecessary. Ten seconds is the primary compromise between temporal specificity and lag-4 VAR stability; 8 s and 12 s are retained as sensitivity windows.

confounds.high_pass: DCT cosine regressors with 128 s cutoff included in nuisance regression

censoring.before_deconvolution: do not delete volumes; include spike regressors in nuisance regression so the run remains evenly sampled
censoring.for_var: drop any target row whose current sample or lagged samples touch a censored volume; lagged rows crossing trial boundaries are also dropped

deconvolution.hrf_normalization: normalize sampled HRF to unit sum before FFT
deconvolution.regularization: lambda = 0.1 * max(abs(FFT(hrf_padded))**2) within each run length
deconvolution.run_handling: perform nuisance regression and deconvolution on each continuous run before trial segmentation; current task has one run per subject

gca.model: bivariate VAR by subject x condition x ROI pair
gca.lag_selection: BIC on unrestricted bivariate VAR; same selected lag used for both directions within a pair
gca.directional_p_value: F-test comparing restricted vs unrestricted lag models
gca.boundary_rule: for lag p, first p rows of each 10-s post-insight segment are excluded; lagged predictors never cross trial boundaries

group_inference.test: two-sided one-sample t-test/Wilcoxon-style summary of subject-level DOI against zero; DOI is primary, raw directional F tests are legacy/descriptive only
group_inference.fdr_family: 3 planned full-run DOI tests = PCC_vmPFC, L_Angular_PCC, L_Angular_vmPFC

robustness.surrogate: within-trial circular shift of the source ROI segment by a random shift >= 3 s and <= segment_length - 3 s where segment length allows; recompute DOI; 5000 permutations per pair x condition
robustness.connectivity_crosscheck: Pearson/Fisher-z FC for same 10-s post-insight segments and ROI pairs

minimal_revision_note: Legacy full-run GCA with requested changes: 3 legacy-coordinate ROIs (PCC, vmPFC, L_Angular), TR verified as 1 s, nuisance regression retained because fMRIPrep preprocessed BOLD is not nuisance-regressed by default, ROI-level HRF/Wiener deconvolution, BIC lag selection over 1-4 TR, and DOI/logGC forward-minus-reverse as interpretable directional contrast.
